description:
**Winter of Code 6.0** is a three-month-long open-source initiative organised by **Google Developer Groups on Campus IIIT Kalyani**, bringing together developers, designers, and tech enthusiasts.

Building on the success of its previous edition, which witnessed **5,000+ participants**, WOC 6.0 offers an opportunity to explore open source through real-world projects, mentorship, and collaboration. Inspired by the contribution-driven model of **Google Summer of Code (GSoC)**, participants get to engage with open-source organisations, connect with experienced mentors, and contribute to projects that make a difference.

Whether you're a first-time contributor or an experienced developer, this is your chance to go beyond tutorials, collaborate with the open-source community, and build something that matters. **Find your project, make your first contribution, and turn this winter into a milestone in your developer journey. The world of open source is waiting. Are you ready to contribute?**

Visit  : [winter-of-code-6.tech](https://www.winter-of-code-6.tech/)
